notes.title: After nearly 10 years of waiting, the sequel to one of the weirdest games I've ever played is finally almost here
notes.notes: lbino Lullaby is intensely bizarre. It's a horror game, except it's not really horrific, just creepy, silly, and... well, weird. Honestly, I don't remember much about it in the way of detail because it's been almost 10 years since it came out—but man, I remember it being weird... Read more.
